validity.recommendation: Find a second report that the Nikitino offtake was commissioned in December 2023.
validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline is real and the length is confirmed by two sources. A Smolensk regional plan PDF lists about 63 kilometers for Nikitino, which is lower than the 67.031 kilometers in the design documents.

fills.researcher_notes: Two sources state 67.031 kilometers for the Nikitino offtake, a design firm page from June 2023 and an expert review notice from June 2021. The sheet value of 67 is the same within rounding.
The expert review notice says the pipeline is part of the Gazprom gasification program. It does not name the company that will hold the pipe, so the owner is kept as recorded.

No wiki citation states this value; not searched this pass. A design page gives 24 thousand cubic meters per hour for the Nikitino gas distribution station. That is an hourly rating, not a yearly figure, so it was not used.

A Smolensk state TV report of 11 December 2023 says the offtake pipe to Nikitino village in Demidov district, more than 60 kilometers long, was built and commissioned as part of the Velizh district gasification. That is one publisher, so the change from construction to operating stays at medium.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: A Smolensk state TV report of 11 December 2023 says the Nikitino offtake, more than 60 kilometers long, was built and put into operation with the Velizh district gasification. No second publisher was found this pass. The design firm page still lists the project under construction objects. A Smolensk regional plan PDF gives a length near 63 kilometers for Nikitino.
status_reviews.recommendation: Change Status to operating and set the start to December 2023 after a second report is found, or accept at medium.

cross_row_leads.finding: The sheet already cites a Smolensk TV page whose title suggests a pipeline was put into operation. Open it and check whether it is this pipeline, because that would change the status.
The TV report gives more than 60 kilometers for the Nikitino offtake. A second independent report of the commissioning would raise the status change to high.

wiki_citations_read.note: The page lists the Smolensk gasification program objects. It does not name the Nikitino gas pipeline.
The government order page was read in full. It does not mention Nikitino or Demidov district.
Read through an April 2024 web archive copy. The state expert review notice gives the offtake length as 67031 meters and says the work belongs to the Gazprom gasification program.
Read through a June 2023 web archive copy. The design firm page gives a pipe of 273 millimeters and 5.4 megapascals with a length of 67.031 kilometers.

summary: "Length confirmed high by two sources, owner medium; capacity unresolved; status change to operating at medium from a December 2023 TV report."
